title: Preserve distinct Git paths in local overlap coverage
body:
## Change and scope

The local overlap inventory could collapse three distinct Git paths containing CR, LF and CRLF into one. Searching only the LF note then incorrectly reported `complete_head_inventory=true`, hiding two unsearched notes.

Capture Git output as bytes and decode explicitly, preserving path identity and the existing failure-warning contract. Seven native Git-object regressions include the false-complete counterexample and a complete CLI check. The existing checkout fixture now runs on Windows while the object fixtures retain newline-path coverage on every platform. This is tooling reliability; no mathematical or selected-frontier change.

## Task and overlap

Started from canonical main `a7638a4ce2a29947457ae8d6bf8cd70a234dfeac`; the fetch before branch publication on 2026-10-31 at approximately 06:28 UTC found the same head. Priority revision 8. Card `portable-replay`, scope key `831cc1a3c8f9ff01b197`; changed scope from the compressed-artifact example to this demonstrated path-inventory failure, using the permitted verifier-engineering expertise override.

By browser submission, main had advanced; GitHub reported the branch automatically mergeable. The checks below apply to the published commit and tree, not a new replay on the advanced main.

Handoff-first orientation, local overlap coverage and targeted live PR searches are recorded in the [review note](https://github.com/josecarlosgonzalezroque-design/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e579ddc0e0b4614184b869f8d20cffdcc26380a6/docs/research/overlap-git-path-bytes.md). The open-PR title search for overlap before branch publication returned no matches. Discussion reading and local sparse coverage were partial; no exhaustive novelty claim. This extends lee-phys's #4419 coverage contract and preserves Ali Romman's #5725 path checks. Nick Petalas's #6161 matching optimization and #5973 invoice-output binding address separate boundaries.

## Validation

Windows 11 build 26300, CPython 3.12.10, Git 2.56.0.windows.2:

- Four new counterexample tests failed against the original helper; all seven new tests pass after the fix.
- Nine relevant test modules: 83 tests, 78 passed and five existing symlink skips.
- Both path suites under isolated optimized Python: 13 tests, 12 passed and one existing symlink skip.
- Selected source-binding baseline and `git diff --check` pass.
- Published Git tree `cd85c49e2749b2a37809544e419de2864b3f79c6` exactly matches the tested local tree.

The review note supplies exact commands, positive/failure controls and the resolved fixture/setup failures. POSIX execution, symlink behavior, historical pinned-package replays and a cold scientific replay are not certified by this run. Hosted CI is pending.

## Credit and next check

Credit Douglas Colkitt, lee-phys, Ali Romman, Nick Petalas and the retained tool contributors. Prepared for josecarlosgonzalezroque-design with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, one agent. Apache-2.0; evidence is author-checked.

The next independent check is to run both path suites on POSIX, including materialized LF names and symlinks. No source pins or scientific certificates were changed.
